definitions.meaning: includes a long bow, recurve bow, composite bow, or crossbow
definitions.quote: Bow includes a long bow, recurve bow, composite bow, or crossbow.

definitions.meaning: any barreled weapon using a propellant, compressed air, explosives, or gas from which any shot, bullet, or other projectile can be discharged, except starting pistols at sporting events with blank ammunition and paintball guns in a licensed facility
definitions.quote: Firearm includes any barreled weapon using a propellant, compressed air, explosives, or gas from which any shot, bullet, or other projectile can be discharged

prohibitions.quote: No person shall discharge a firearm or bow within the City.

exceptions.quote: a peace officer, a conservation officer under the Wildlife Act, an enforcement officer of the Department of Fisheries and Oceans, an employee of the Canadian Wildlife service, or a person appointed to enforce the City’s Animal Control Bylaw, when engaged in the lawful performance of their duties

land located in the Agricultural Land Reserve where a firearm or bow is discharged for the purpose of: (a) the protection of agricultural crops, livestock, or domestic animals from wildlife; or (b) the humane destruction of livestock.

quotes.quote: FINALLY ADOPTED this thirteenth day of July, 2015.
No person shall discharge a firearm or bow within the City.
